steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 46-second launch film for [your product], 16:9 at 1920x1080, from the "16-ai-workspace-launch" template in lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates (MIT, rendered with HyperFrames).

Setup: clone https://github.com/lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates into ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates, then run `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 doctor` and fix anything it reports (it needs Node.js 22 or newer, FFmpeg and Chrome).

The film, scene by scene:
1. dark: 'Docs here. Chats there. Tasks everywhere.' while app tiles pop in around the text, then everything collapses into a dot
2. a light disc opens around the logo; 'Where teams and agents • Think/Build/Ship together.' with two doodle avatars
3. the camera pans to 'The AI workspace that works for you.' and the product board rises and fills the frame; agents move two cards
4. 'Bring everything into one system of record.' next to a meetings database, a recording pill and a 'Notes captured' chip
5. a question is typed, the answer assembles as a donut, bar and line chart with source chips; 'Get answers, instantly. With citations.'
6. an agent page and a task board: the agent works, updates five pages and takes a ticket; '24/7, Keep work moving with agents.'
7. dark slide: 'Build agents that …' cycling through four uses with a progress track
8. 'Trusted by teams that ship.' with a 5x3 wall of customer names and three counting stat cards
9. end card: mark and wordmark, tagline, a button the cursor clicks, domain

Before you change anything, learn [your product] from [your product URL] and ask me only for what you cannot find: its name, what it does in one line, the copy each scene needs, and two or three brand colours as #rrggbb. The demo brand, names, prices, numbers, ratings and quotes are placeholders: replace every one with something true for my product, or remove it. Never ship a made-up number or testimonial.

Then:
1. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/new-video.mjs 16-ai-workspace-launch my-video`
2. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video` to list the variables.
3. Write values.json, keeping each value close to its default's length and format (the same number of |-separated items, plain numbers where the default is a number), then apply it with `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video values.json`.
4. `cd my-video && npx hyperframes@0.8.96 snapshot --at 1,15,31,45`, look at every frame, and fix any text that overflows or any colour that is hard to read.
5. `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 render -f 60 -q high -w 4 -o out.mp4`, then watch it through once before you hand it over.

Template notes: The board (COLS), the meetings table (ROWS), the chart numbers, the agent's reply and the task cards are data arrays in the script; the mark is the MARK() SVG. Stats are 'value | label' and count up from zero, keeping any prefix or suffix. The customer names are made up: replace them with real customers only if you have permission to show their names, and replace the stats with real numbers or remove the slide.
